# UI Vault

> A personal, frontend-only catalog of UI components from free, vendorable sources
> (open-source animated React libraries and component registries), organized into one
> categorized, searchable library. Every entry ships free code with its source, license,
> install command and — where vendored — a live React preview. No backend: the catalog itself
> lives in TypeScript files under src/data (1991 entries, 29 sources, 23 categories).

## Sources

- [React Bits](https://reactbits.dev) — Open-source animated, interactive & fully customizable React components. (MIT, live-previewable, 25 cataloged)
- [Motion Primitives](https://motion-primitives.com) — UI kit to make beautiful, animated interfaces, faster. (MIT, live-previewable, 18 cataloged)
- [FancyComponents](https://fancycomponents.dev) — Make the web fun again. (MIT, live-previewable, 16 cataloged)
- [NumberFlow](https://number-flow.barvian.me) — Animated number component, for React, Vue, Svelte & vanilla. (MIT, live-previewable, 4 cataloged)
- [Watermelon UI](https://watermelon.sh) — 600+ free open-source components, 100+ animations, 230+ blocks. (Free, live-previewable, 12 cataloged)
- [Aceternity UI](https://ui.aceternity.com) — The React component library for beautiful landing pages. (Freemium, live-previewable, 15 cataloged)
- [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com) — The canonical copy-paste component collection you own outright. (MIT, live-previewable, 65 cataloged)
- [Magic UI](https://magicui.design) — UI library for design engineers. (MIT, live-previewable, 76 cataloged)
- [Animata](https://animata.design) — Move, scale, rotate and animate with real components. (MIT, live-previewable, 154 cataloged)
- [Animate UI](https://animate-ui.com) — Animated components for your next project. (MIT + Commons Clause, live-previewable, 154 cataloged)
- [Launch UI](https://www.launchuicomponents.com) — Open-source components for your next launch. (MIT, live-previewable, 16 cataloged)
- [Origin UI](https://coss.com/origin) — 600+ copy-paste components, 30 families — the deepest form catalog anywhere. (MIT, live-previewable, 31 cataloged)
- [COSS UI](https://coss.com/ui) — Origin UI's actively developed successor — Base UI primitives plus 500+ particles. (MIT, live-previewable, 111 cataloged)
- [Cult UI](https://cult-ui.com) — Animated, modern components designed for effortless integration. (MIT, live-previewable, 77 cataloged)
- [Kibo UI](https://www.kibo-ui.com) — The shadcn registry for everything that doesn't exist yet. (MIT, live-previewable, 40 cataloged)
- [Streamdown](https://streamdown.ai) — A drop-in replacement for react-markdown, designed for AI-powered streaming. (Free, live-previewable, 5 cataloged)
- [Generative Loaders](https://generativeloaders.com) — React loaders for generative UI. (MIT, live-previewable, 46 cataloged)
- [UI SDK](https://ui-sdk.dev) — A library of behaviors to build your components. (Free, live-previewable, 55 cataloged)
- [wterm](https://wterm.dev) — A terminal emulator for the web. (Free, live-previewable, 1 cataloged)
- [Skullet](https://skullet.lochie.me) — Smart skeleton states for React, Vue, Svelte, and vanilla JavaScript. (MIT, live-previewable, 1 cataloged)
- [EasyUI](https://easyui.site) — Micro-animated, physics-based, dark-mode-first React components. (MIT, live-previewable, 137 cataloged)
- [editorcn](https://www.rtecn.space) — Rich text editors for React, built on Tiptap with shadcn/ui tokens. (MIT, live-previewable, 16 cataloged)
- [loading.dev](https://loading.dev) — Beautiful loading indicators for React. (MIT, live-previewable, 36 cataloged)
- [Its Hover](https://itshover.com) — Animated icons that come alive on hover. (Free, live-previewable, 263 cataloged)
- [Amicro](https://amicro.vercel.app) — Open-source React micro-interactions and transitions powered by Motion. (MIT, live-previewable, 174 cataloged)
- [Kokonut UI](https://kokonutui.com) — Free open-source React components for AI chat and agents. (MIT, live-previewable, 116 cataloged)
- [Arc UI](https://uiarc.dev) — Components and blocks designed for AI-assisted frontend development. (MIT, live-previewable, 143 cataloged)
- [snapcn](https://snapcn.dev) — shadcn-style video components for Remotion. (MIT, live-previewable, 62 cataloged)
- [beUI](https://beui.dev) — Animated components for React and Next.js. (MIT, live-previewable, 122 cataloged)

## Categories

### Components
- `text-animation` Text & Typography (163) — Animated text reveals, scrambles, gradients and typographic effects.
- `backgrounds` Backgrounds (80) — Shader, gradient and generative backgrounds for heroes and panels.
- `3d-webgl` 3D & WebGL (7) — Globes, physics and Three.js scenes that drop into a page.
- `buttons` Buttons & Actions (100) — Buttons with borders, magnets and sparks — actions that feel alive.
- `cards` Cards & Bento (80) — Spotlight, tilt, bento and stacking card treatments.
- `navigation` Navigation (86) — Navbars, docks, sidebars, tabs, breadcrumbs and scroll progress.
- `forms` Forms & Inputs (246) — Inputs, selects, OTP, uploads, sliders, toggles and date pickers.
- `overlays` Overlays (130) — Dialogs, drawers, popovers, tooltips, toasts and command bars.
- `numbers` Numbers & Counters (19) — Animated numbers, tickers and odometers.
- `micro-interactions` Micro-interactions (429) — Cursor tricks, physics toys and small moments of delight.
- `feedback` Feedback & Status (287) — Spinners, progress, skeletons, empty states and notifications.
- `data-display` Data Display (139) — Tables, charts, stats, badges and avatars for showing data.
- `chat` Chat & AI (78) — Chat and AI conversation UI — bubbles, message streams, attachments.

### Blocks
- `hero` Hero Sections (31) — Above-the-fold sections that set the tone of a page.
- `features` Feature Sections (14) — Feature grids, bento layouts and product story sections.
- `pricing` Pricing (6) — Pricing tables, plan comparisons and checkout prompts.
- `testimonials` Testimonials & Social Proof (7) — Quotes, marquees, logos and proof sections.
- `cta` CTA Sections (5) — Big closing calls-to-action and conversion moments.
- `faq` FAQ (18) — Frequently-asked-question sections and accordion groups.
- `footers` Footers (3) — Multi-column footers, sitemaps and newsletter captures.
- `sections-misc` Other Sections (51) — Team, blog, contact, stats, onboarding and everything else.

### Templates
- `dashboards` Dashboards (3) — Complete admin and analytics app layouts.
- `auth` Login & Signup (9) — Auth screens, OTP flows and onboarding.
